summary: API 4XX errors are logged as "status {status_code} received by user {user_name} attempting to access {url_path} from {remote_addr}"; change it in Log Format For API 4XX Errors under Settings > Automation Execution > Logging, with variables status_code, user_name, url_path, remote_addr and error.
questions: How do I change the API 4XX error log format?
How do I include the error message in 4XX logs?
Which variables can I use in the 4XX log format?
